description: Replaces Shopify Stocky's retired forecasting brain. Computes margin-weighted ABC classes, stockout-adjusted daily sales velocity, demand + lead-time variability safety stock (SS = Z * sqrt(LT*sigma_d^2 + d^2*sigma_LT^2)), reorder points, inventory position (On-Hand + On-Order - Committed - Backorders), days of cover, and carton-rounded order recommendations. Free Local Sandbox processes up to 25 SKUs per call; Pro/License unlocks unlimited SKUs and Live Shopify sync.

demo_mode.description: Run immediately against the built-in US Shopify merchant dataset (no API keys required).

inventory_csv.description: Raw CSV exported from Shopify Admin Products or merchant reorder spreadsheet.

review_period_days.description: Days between purchasing review cycles (e.g., 7 for weekly, 14 for bi-weekly).

service_level.description: Target cycle service level used for Z-score safety stock calculation (85%=1.04, 90%=1.28, 95%=1.65, 97.5%=1.96, 99%=2.33).

backorders.description: Customer backorder commitments not yet covered.

barcode.description: Optional UPC/EAN/GTIN barcode for Shopify POS scanner receiving and Transfers CSV bulk import.

case_pack.description: Vendor carton/case-pack multiple (e.g., 12 or 24 units per box).

committed.description: Units allocated to unfulfilled customer orders.

daily_demand_std_dev.description: Optional daily demand standard deviation. Defaults to 0.35 * adjusted daily velocity when omitted.

lead_time_days.description: Average supplier lead time in calendar days.

lead_time_std_dev_days.description: Supplier lead-time standard deviation in days (captures port/carrier delay variance).

on_order.description: Units already in transit on open supplier POs.

retail_price_usd.description: Selling price per unit in USD (used for margin-weighted ABC classification).

sku.description: Unique variant SKU code matching Shopify Variant SKU.

sku_moq.description: Minimum order quantity for this specific SKU when ordered.

stockout_days.description: Days within window_days where the SKU had 0 sellable stock (prevents downward velocity bias).

unit_cost_usd.description: Landed supplier cost per unit in USD.

units_sold_window.description: Total units sold during the lookback window.

window_days.description: Total calendar days in the sales lookback window (e.g., 30, 60, or 90).

supplier_rules.description: Optional supplier rules (e.g. from migrate_stocky_csv_snapshot) to apply vendor lead_time_days overrides.

estimated_freight_usd.description: Estimated ocean/air/LTL freight + drayage cost in USD for this supplier shipment, allocated across PO lines for true landed cost.

import_duty_pct.description: Estimated US import tariff / customs duty percentage applied to FOB merchandise cost (e.g., 25 for 25% Section 301 tariff).

lead_time_days.description: Overrides default lead time for all SKUs from this vendor.

min_order_units.description: Vendor-wide minimum total units per Purchase Order.

min_order_value_usd.description: Vendor-wide minimum PO dollar subtotal (e.g., $1,500 minimum or free-freight threshold).

payment_terms.description: Agreed payment terms (e.g., Net 30, 50% Deposit / 50% BOL).

use_live_shopify.description: Pull live variants and paid order velocity from configured Shopify Admin GraphQL API (Pro / License).

window_days.description: Lookback window in days when parsing CSV or querying live Shopify orders.

name: calculate_replenishment_plan
title: Calculate Stockout-Adjusted Replenishment & Reorder Points
